questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses inversion to emphasise the speaker’s surprise at the news?
options: It was not until he arrived that I realised he had left without me.
Only when she finished her report did the director acknowledge her efforts.
Had she not studied so hard, she would have failed the exam.
Not until the last minute did the team realise they needed to prepare better.
questions.answer: Only when she finished her report did the director acknowledge her efforts.

questions.question: Which sentence uses a cleft construction to highlight the subject of the main clause?
options: It is essential that we discuss this matter thoroughly before making a decision.
The fact that he arrived late was entirely his own fault.
What surprised me was his willingness to take responsibility for the mistake.
She insisted that he had broken the rules, despite her earlier denial.
questions.answer: What surprised me was his willingness to take responsibility for the mistake.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly employs a third conditional with the subjunctive mood to express regret about a past situation?
options: If I had known the truth earlier, I would have helped him.
If he had not spent so much time on his hobby, he would have passed the exam.
She wished she had studied more before taking the test.
They suggested that we leave immediately if the weather worsened.
questions.answer: If he had not spent so much time on his hobby, he would have passed the exam.

questions.question: Which sentence uses ellipsis to achieve conciseness in a formal academic context?
options: Having analysed the data, we concluded that the hypothesis was flawed.
The study, which was conducted over two years, demonstrated significant findings.
The participants were divided into two groups, one receiving treatment, the other not.
It was evident that the experiment’s results were inconclusive, thus requiring further investigation.
questions.answer: Having analysed the data, we concluded that the hypothesis was flawed.

questions.question: Which sentence demonstrates the use of a formal register with passive voice and modal verbs to convey a neutral or detached tone?
options: They are reported to have conducted extensive research on the topic.
It is important that we consider all aspects of the proposal carefully.
She insisted that he should be given the credit for the project’s success.
The meeting was adjourned until next week due to unforeseen circumstances.
questions.answer: It is important that we consider all aspects of the proposal carefully.
